admin-https-ssl-versions.name: admin-https-ssl-versions
admin-https-ssl-versions.help: Allowed TLS versions for web administration.

admin-https-ssl-ciphersuites.name: admin-https-ssl-ciphersuites
admin-https-ssl-ciphersuites.help: Select one or more TLS 1.3 ciphersuites to enable. Does not affect ciphers in TLS 1.2 and below. At least one must be enabled. To disable all, remove TLS1.3 from admin-https-ssl-versions.

admin-https-ssl-banned-ciphers.name: admin-https-ssl-banned-ciphers
admin-https-ssl-banned-ciphers.help: Select one or more cipher technologies that cannot be used in GUI HTTPS negotiations. Only applies to TLS 1.2 and below.

options.name: RSA
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using RSA key.

options.name: DHE
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using authenticated ephemeral DH key agreement.

options.name: ECDHE
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using authenticated ephemeral ECDH key agreement.

options.name: DSS
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using DSS authentication.

options.name: ECDSA
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using ECDSA authentication.

options.name: AES
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using either 128 or 256 bit AES.

options.name: AESGCM
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using AES in Galois Counter Mode (GCM).

options.name: CAMELLIA
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using either 128 or 256 bit CAMELLIA.

options.name: 3DES
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using triple DES.

options.name: SHA1
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using HMAC-SHA1.

options.name: SHA256
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using HMAC-SHA256.

options.name: SHA384
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using HMAC-SHA384.

options.name: STATIC
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using static keys.

options.name: CHACHA20
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using ChaCha20.

options.name: ARIA
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using ARIA.

options.name: AESCCM
options.help: Ban the use of cipher suites using AESCCM.

admintimeout.name: admintimeout
admintimeout.help: Number of minutes before an idle administrator session times out (1 - 480 minutes (8 hours), default = 5). A shorter idle timeout is more secure.

admin-console-timeout.name: admin-console-timeout
admin-console-timeout.help: Console login timeout that overrides the admin timeout value (15 - 300 seconds, default = 0, which disables the timeout).

ssd-trim-freq.name: ssd-trim-freq
ssd-trim-freq.help: How often to run SSD Trim (default = weekly). SSD Trim prevents SSD drive data loss by finding and isolating errors.

ssd-trim-hour.name: ssd-trim-hour
ssd-trim-hour.help: Hour of the day on which to run SSD Trim (0 - 23, default = 1).

ssd-trim-min.name: ssd-trim-min
ssd-trim-min.help: Minute of the hour on which to run SSD Trim (0 - 59, 60 for random).

ssd-trim-weekday.name: ssd-trim-weekday
ssd-trim-weekday.help: Day of week to run SSD Trim.

ssd-trim-date.name: ssd-trim-date
ssd-trim-date.help: Date within a month to run ssd trim.

admin-concurrent.name: admin-concurrent
admin-concurrent.help: Enable/disable concurrent administrator logins. Use policy-auth-concurrent for firewall authenticated users.

admin-lockout-threshold.name: admin-lockout-threshold
admin-lockout-threshold.help: Number of failed login attempts before an administrator account is locked out for the admin-lockout-duration.

admin-lockout-duration.name: admin-lockout-duration
admin-lockout-duration.help: Amount of time in seconds that an administrator account is locked out after reaching the admin-lockout-threshold for repeated failed login attempts.

refresh.name: refresh
refresh.help: Statistics refresh interval second(s) in GUI.

daily-restart.name: daily-restart
daily-restart.help: Enable/disable daily restart of FortiGate unit. Use the restart-time option to set the time of day for the restart.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable daily reboot of the FortiGate.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable daily reboot of the FortiGate.

options.name: time
options.help: Enable daily restart of WAD workers.

options.name: memory
options.help: Enable restart of WAD workers based on memory usage.

wad-restart-end-time.name: wad-restart-end-time
wad-restart-end-time.help: WAD workers daily restart end time (hh:mm).

wad-p2s-max-body-size.name: wad-p2s-max-body-size
wad-p2s-max-body-size.help: Maximum size of the body of the local out HTTP request (1 - 32 Mbytes, default = 4).

admin-login-max.name: admin-login-max
admin-login-max.help: Maximum number of administrators who can be logged in at the same time (1 - 100, default = 100).

remoteauthtimeout.name: remoteauthtimeout
remoteauthtimeout.help: Number of seconds that the FortiGate waits for responses from remote RADIUS, LDAP, or TACACS+ authentication servers. (1-300 sec, default = 5).

ldapconntimeout.name: ldapconntimeout
ldapconntimeout.help: Global timeout for connections with remote LDAP servers in milliseconds (1 - 300000, default 500).

batch-cmdb.name: batch-cmdb
batch-cmdb.help: Enable/disable batch mode, allowing you to enter a series of CLI commands that will execute as a group once they are loaded.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable batch mode to execute in CMDB server.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable batch mode to execute in CMDB server.

multi-factor-authentication.name: multi-factor-authentication
multi-factor-authentication.help: Enforce all login methods to require an additional authentication factor (default = optional).

options.name: optional
options.help: Do not enforce all login methods to require an additional authentication factor (controlled by user settings).

options.name: mandatory
options.help: Enforce all login methods to require an additional authentication factor.

ssl-min-proto-version.name: ssl-min-proto-version
ssl-min-proto-version.help: Minimum supported protocol version for SSL/TLS connections (default = TLSv1.2).

autorun-log-fsck.name: autorun-log-fsck
autorun-log-fsck.help: Enable/disable automatic log partition check after ungraceful shutdown.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable automatic log partition check after ungraceful shutdown.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable automatic log partition check after ungraceful shutdown.

timezone.name: timezone
timezone.help: Timezone database name. Enter ? to view the list of timezone.

traffic-priority.name: traffic-priority
traffic-priority.help: Choose Type of Service (ToS) or Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) for traffic prioritization in traffic shaping.

traffic-priority-level.name: traffic-priority-level
traffic-priority-level.help: Default system-wide level of priority for traffic prioritization.

quic-udp-payload-size-shaping-per-cid.name: quic-udp-payload-size-shaping-per-cid
quic-udp-payload-size-shaping-per-cid.help: Enable/disable UDP payload size shaping per connection ID (default = enable).

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable UDP payload size shaping per connection ID.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable UDP payload size shaping per connection ID.

quic-ack-thresold.name: quic-ack-thresold
quic-ack-thresold.help: Maximum number of unacknowledged packets before sending ACK (2 - 5, default = 3).

quic-tls-handshake-timeout.name: quic-tls-handshake-timeout
quic-tls-handshake-timeout.help: Time-to-live (TTL) for TLS handshake in seconds (1 - 60, default = 5).

anti-replay.name: anti-replay
anti-replay.help: Level of checking for packet replay and TCP sequence checking.

send-pmtu-icmp.name: send-pmtu-icmp
send-pmtu-icmp.help: Enable/disable sending of path maximum transmission unit (PMTU) - ICMP destination unreachable packet and to support PMTUD protocol on your network to reduce fragmentation of packets.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable sending of PMTU ICMP destination unreachable packet.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable sending of PMTU ICMP destination unreachable packet.

revision-image-auto-backup.name: revision-image-auto-backup
revision-image-auto-backup.help: Enable/disable back-up of the latest image revision after the firmware is upgraded.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable revision image backup automatically when upgrading image.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable revision image backup automatically when upgrading image.

revision-backup-on-logout.name: revision-backup-on-logout
revision-backup-on-logout.help: Enable/disable back-up of the latest configuration revision when an administrator logs out of the CLI or GUI.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable revision config backup automatically when logout.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable revision config backup automatically when logout.

hostname.name: hostname
hostname.help: FortiGate unit's hostname. Most models will truncate names longer than 24 characters. Some models support hostnames up to 35 characters.

strong-crypto.name: strong-crypto
strong-crypto.help: Enable to use strong encryption and only allow strong ciphers and digest for HTTPS/SSH/TLS/SSL functions.

ssl-static-key-ciphers.name: ssl-static-key-ciphers
ssl-static-key-ciphers.help: Enable/disable static key ciphers in SSL/TLS connections (e.g. AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256).

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable static key ciphers in SSL/TLS connections.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable static key ciphers in SSL/TLS connections.

snat-route-change.name: snat-route-change
snat-route-change.help: Enable/disable the ability to change the source NAT route.

ipv6-snat-route-change.name: ipv6-snat-route-change
ipv6-snat-route-change.help: Enable/disable the ability to change the IPv6 source NAT route.

dh-params.name: dh-params
dh-params.help: Number of bits to use in the Diffie-Hellman exchange for HTTPS/SSH protocols.

fds-statistics.name: fds-statistics
fds-statistics.help: Enable/disable sending IPS, Application Control, and AntiVirus data to FortiGuard. This data is used to improve FortiGuard services and is not shared with external parties and is protected by Fortinet's privacy policy.

fds-statistics-period.name: fds-statistics-period
fds-statistics-period.help: FortiGuard statistics collection period in minutes. (1 - 1440 min (1 min to 24 hours), default = 60).

tcp-option.name: tcp-option
tcp-option.help: Enable SACK, timestamp and MSS TCP options.

lldp-transmission.name: lldp-transmission
lldp-transmission.help: Enable/disable Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) transmission.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable transmission of Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP).

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable transmission of Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP).

lldp-reception.name: lldp-reception
lldp-reception.help: Enable/disable Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) reception.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable reception of Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP).

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable reception of Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP).

proxy-auth-timeout.name: proxy-auth-timeout
proxy-auth-timeout.help: Authentication timeout in minutes for authenticated users (1 - 10000 min, default = 10).

proxy-keep-alive-mode.name: proxy-keep-alive-mode
proxy-keep-alive-mode.help: Control if users must re-authenticate after a session is closed, traffic has been idle, or from the point at which the user was authenticated.

options.name: session
options.help: Proxy keep-alive timeout begins at the closure of the session.

options.name: traffic
options.help: Proxy keep-alive timeout begins after traffic has not been received.

options.name: re-authentication
options.help: Proxy keep-alive timeout begins when the user was authenticated.

proxy-re-authentication-time.name: proxy-re-authentication-time
proxy-re-authentication-time.help: The time limit that users must re-authenticate if proxy-keep-alive-mode is set to re-authenticate (1  - 86400 sec, default=30s.

proxy-auth-lifetime.name: proxy-auth-lifetime
proxy-auth-lifetime.help: Enable/disable authenticated users lifetime control. This is a cap on the total time a proxy user can be authenticated for after which re-authentication will take place.

proxy-auth-lifetime-timeout.name: proxy-auth-lifetime-timeout
proxy-auth-lifetime-timeout.help: Lifetime timeout in minutes for authenticated users (5  - 65535 min, default=480 (8 hours)).

proxy-resource-mode.name: proxy-resource-mode
proxy-resource-mode.help: Enable/disable use of the maximum memory usage on the FortiGate unit's proxy processing of resources, such as block lists, allow lists, and external resources.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable use of the maximum memory usage.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable use of the maximum memory usage.

proxy-cert-use-mgmt-vdom.name: proxy-cert-use-mgmt-vdom
proxy-cert-use-mgmt-vdom.help: Enable/disable using management VDOM to send requests.

sys-perf-log-interval.name: sys-perf-log-interval
sys-perf-log-interval.help: Time in minutes between updates of performance statistics logging. (1 - 15 min, default = 5, 0 = disabled).

check-protocol-header.name: check-protocol-header
check-protocol-header.help: Level of checking performed on protocol headers. Strict checking is more thorough but may affect performance. Loose checking is OK in most cases.

vip-arp-range.name: vip-arp-range
vip-arp-range.help: Controls the number of ARPs that the FortiGate sends for a Virtual IP (VIP) address range.

options.name: unlimited
options.help: Send ARPs for all addresses in VIP range.

options.name: restricted
options.help: Send ARPs for the first 8192 addresses in VIP range.

reset-sessionless-tcp.name: reset-sessionless-tcp
reset-sessionless-tcp.help: Action to perform if the FortiGate receives a TCP packet but cannot find a corresponding session in its session table. NAT/Route mode only.

allow-traffic-redirect.name: allow-traffic-redirect
allow-traffic-redirect.help: Disable to prevent traffic with same local ingress and egress interface from being forwarded without policy check.

ipv6-allow-traffic-redirect.name: ipv6-allow-traffic-redirect
ipv6-allow-traffic-redirect.help: Disable to prevent IPv6 traffic with same local ingress and egress interface from being forwarded without policy check.

strict-dirty-session-check.name: strict-dirty-session-check
strict-dirty-session-check.help: Enable to check the session against the original policy when revalidating. This can prevent dropping of redirected sessions when web-filtering and authentication are enabled together. If this option is enabled, the FortiGate unit deletes a session if a routing or policy change causes the session to no longer match the policy that originally allowed the session.

tcp-halfclose-timer.name: tcp-halfclose-timer
tcp-halfclose-timer.help: Number of seconds the FortiGate unit should wait to close a session after one peer has sent a FIN packet but the other has not responded (1 - 86400 sec (1 day), default = 120).

tcp-halfopen-timer.name: tcp-halfopen-timer
tcp-halfopen-timer.help: Number of seconds the FortiGate unit should wait to close a session after one peer has sent an open session packet but the other has not responded (1 - 86400 sec (1 day), default = 10).

tcp-timewait-timer.name: tcp-timewait-timer
tcp-timewait-timer.help: Length of the TCP TIME-WAIT state in seconds (1 - 300 sec, default = 1).

tcp-rst-timer.name: tcp-rst-timer
tcp-rst-timer.help: Length of the TCP CLOSE state in seconds (5 - 300 sec, default = 5).

udp-idle-timer.name: udp-idle-timer
udp-idle-timer.help: UDP connection session timeout. This command can be useful in managing CPU and memory resources (1 - 86400 seconds (1 day), default = 60).

block-session-timer.name: block-session-timer
block-session-timer.help: Duration in seconds for blocked sessions (1 - 300 sec  (5 minutes), default = 30).

ip-src-port-range.name: ip-src-port-range
ip-src-port-range.help: IP source port range used for traffic originating from the FortiGate unit.

pre-login-banner.name: pre-login-banner
pre-login-banner.help: Enable/disable displaying the administrator access disclaimer message on the login page before an administrator logs in.

post-login-banner.name: post-login-banner
post-login-banner.help: Enable/disable displaying the administrator access disclaimer message after an administrator successfully logs in.

av-failopen.name: av-failopen
av-failopen.help: Set the action to take if the FortiGate is running low on memory or the proxy connection limit has been reached.

options.name: pass
options.help: Bypass the antivirus system when memory is low. Antivirus scanning resumes when the low memory condition is resolved.

options.name: off
options.help: Stop accepting new AV sessions when entering conserve mode, but continue to process current active sessions.

options.name: one-shot
options.help: Bypass the antivirus system when memory is low.

av-failopen-session.name: av-failopen-session
av-failopen-session.help: When enabled and a proxy for a protocol runs out of room in its session table, that protocol goes into failopen mode and enacts the action specified by av-failopen.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable AV fail open session option.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable AV fail open session option.

memory-use-threshold-extreme.name: memory-use-threshold-extreme
memory-use-threshold-extreme.help: Threshold at which memory usage is considered extreme (new sessions are dropped) (% of total RAM, default = 95).

memory-use-threshold-red.name: memory-use-threshold-red
memory-use-threshold-red.help: Threshold at which memory usage forces the FortiGate to enter conserve mode (% of total RAM, default = 88).

memory-use-threshold-green.name: memory-use-threshold-green
memory-use-threshold-green.help: Threshold at which memory usage forces the FortiGate to exit conserve mode (% of total RAM, default = 82).

ip-fragment-mem-thresholds.name: ip-fragment-mem-thresholds
ip-fragment-mem-thresholds.help: Maximum memory (MB) used to reassemble IPv4/IPv6 fragments.

ip-fragment-timeout.name: ip-fragment-timeout
ip-fragment-timeout.help: Timeout value in seconds for any fragment not being reassembled

ipv6-fragment-timeout.name: ipv6-fragment-timeout
ipv6-fragment-timeout.help: Timeout value in seconds for any IPv6 fragment not being reassembled

cpu-use-threshold.name: cpu-use-threshold
cpu-use-threshold.help: Threshold at which CPU usage is reported (% of total CPU, default = 90).

log-single-cpu-high.name: log-single-cpu-high
log-single-cpu-high.help: Enable/disable logging the event of a single CPU core reaching CPU usage threshold.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable logging the event of a single CPU core reaching CPU usage threshold.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable logging the event of a single CPU core reaching CPU usage threshold.

check-reset-range.name: check-reset-range
check-reset-range.help: Configure ICMP error message verification. You can either apply strict RST range checking or disable it.

single-vdom-npuvlink.name: single-vdom-npuvlink
single-vdom-npuvlink.help: Enable/disable NPU VDOMs links for single VDOM.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable NPU VDOM links for single VDOM.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable NPU VDOM links for single VDOM.

vdom-mode.name: vdom-mode
vdom-mode.help: Enable/disable support for multiple virtual domains (VDOMs).

upgrade-report.name: upgrade-report
upgrade-report.help: Enable/disable the generation of an upgrade report when upgrading the firmware.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable to automatically generate upgrade report when upgrading the firmware.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable upgrade report generation when upgrading the firmware.

admin-port.name: admin-port
admin-port.help: Administrative access port for HTTP. (1 - 65535, default = 80).

admin-sport.name: admin-sport
admin-sport.help: Administrative access port for HTTPS. (1 - 65535, default = 443).

admin-host.name: admin-host
admin-host.help: Administrative host for HTTP and HTTPS. When set, will be used in lieu of the client's Host header for any redirection.

admin-https-redirect.name: admin-https-redirect
admin-https-redirect.help: Enable/disable redirection of HTTP administration access to HTTPS.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable redirecting HTTP administration access to HTTPS.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable redirecting HTTP administration access to HTTPS.

admin-hsts-max-age.name: admin-hsts-max-age
admin-hsts-max-age.help: HTTPS Strict-Transport-Security header max-age in seconds. A value of 0 will reset any HSTS records in the browser.When admin-https-redirect is disabled the header max-age will be 0.

admin-ssh-password.name: admin-ssh-password
admin-ssh-password.help: Enable/disable password authentication for SSH admin access.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable password authentication for SSH admin access.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable password authentication for SSH admin access.

admin-restrict-local.name: admin-restrict-local
admin-restrict-local.help: Enable/disable local admin authentication restriction when remote authenticator is up and running (default = disable).

options.name: all
options.help: Enable local admin authentication restriction including console.

options.name: non-console-only
options.help: Enable local admin authentication restriction excluding console.

admin-ssh-port.name: admin-ssh-port
admin-ssh-port.help: Administrative access port for SSH. (1 - 65535, default = 22).

admin-ssh-grace-time.name: admin-ssh-grace-time
admin-ssh-grace-time.help: Maximum time in seconds permitted between making an SSH connection to the FortiGate unit and authenticating (10 - 3600 sec (1 hour), default 120).

admin-telnet-port.name: admin-telnet-port
admin-telnet-port.help: Administrative access port for TELNET. (1 - 65535, default = 23).

admin-forticloud-sso-login.name: admin-forticloud-sso-login
admin-forticloud-sso-login.help: Enable/disable FortiCloud admin login via SSO.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable FortiCloud admin login via SSO.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable FortiCloud admin login via SSO.

admin-reset-button.name: admin-reset-button
admin-reset-button.help: Press the reset button can reset to factory default.

options.name: enable
options.help: press the reset button can reset to factory default

options.name: disable
options.help: press the reset button cannot reset to factory default

admin-server-cert.name: admin-server-cert
admin-server-cert.help: Server certificate that the FortiGate uses for HTTPS administrative connections.

admin-https-pki-required.name: admin-https-pki-required
admin-https-pki-required.help: Enable/disable admin login method. Enable to force administrators to provide a valid certificate to log in if PKI is enabled. Disable to allow administrators to log in with a certificate or password.

options.name: enable
options.help: Admin users must provide a valid certificate when PKI is enabled for HTTPS admin access.

options.name: disable
options.help: Admin users can login by providing a valid certificate or password.

wifi-certificate.name: wifi-certificate
wifi-certificate.help: Certificate to use for WiFi authentication.

dhcp-lease-backup-interval.name: dhcp-lease-backup-interval
dhcp-lease-backup-interval.help: DHCP leases backup interval in seconds (10 - 3600, default = 60).

wifi-ca-certificate.name: wifi-ca-certificate
wifi-ca-certificate.help: CA certificate that verifies the WiFi certificate.

auth-ike-saml-port.name: auth-ike-saml-port
auth-ike-saml-port.help: User IKE SAML authentication port (0 - 65535, default = 1001).

auth-keepalive.name: auth-keepalive
auth-keepalive.help: Enable to prevent user authentication sessions from timing out when idle.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable use of keep alive to extend authentication.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable use of keep alive to extend authentication.

policy-auth-concurrent.name: policy-auth-concurrent
policy-auth-concurrent.help: Number of concurrent firewall use logins from the same user (1 - 100, default = 0 means no limit).

auth-session-limit.name: auth-session-limit
auth-session-limit.help: Action to take when the number of allowed user authenticated sessions is reached.

options.name: logout-inactive
options.help: Logout the most inactive user authenticated sessions.

auth-cert.name: auth-cert
auth-cert.help: Server certificate that the FortiGate uses for HTTPS firewall authentication connections.

clt-cert-req.name: clt-cert-req
clt-cert-req.help: Enable/disable requiring administrators to have a client certificate to log into the GUI using HTTPS.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable require client certificate for GUI login.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable require client certificate for GUI login.

fortiservice-port.name: fortiservice-port
fortiservice-port.help: FortiService port (1 - 65535, default = 8013). Used by FortiClient endpoint compliance. Older versions of FortiClient used a different port.

cfg-save.name: cfg-save
cfg-save.help: Configuration file save mode for CLI changes.

options.name: revert

pba-interim-log.help: Port block allocation interim logging interval (600 - 86400 seconds, default = 0 which disables interim logging).

permit-any-host.name: permit-any-host
permit-any-host.help: Enable/disable fullcone NAT. Accept UDP packets from any host.

arp-reply.name: arp-reply
arp-reply.help: Enable/disable replying to ARP requests when an IP Pool is added to a policy (default = enable).

arp-intf.name: arp-intf
arp-intf.help: Select an interface from available options that will reply to ARP requests. (If blank, any is selected).

source-prefix6.name: source-prefix6
source-prefix6.help: Source IPv6 network to be translated (format = xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx/xxx, default = ::/0).

client-prefix-length.name: client-prefix-length
client-prefix-length.help: Subnet length of a single deterministic NAT64 client (1 - 128, default = 64).

tcp-session-quota.name: tcp-session-quota
tcp-session-quota.help: Maximum number of concurrent TCP sessions allowed per client (0 - 2097000, default = 0 which means no limit).

udp-session-quota.name: udp-session-quota
udp-session-quota.help: Maximum number of concurrent UDP sessions allowed per client (0 - 2097000, default = 0 which means no limit).

icmp-session-quota.name: icmp-session-quota
icmp-session-quota.help: Maximum number of concurrent ICMP sessions allowed per client (0 - 2097000, default = 0 which means no limit).

privileged-port-use-pba.name: privileged-port-use-pba
privileged-port-use-pba.help: Enable/disable selection of the external port from the port block allocation for NAT'ing privileged ports (deafult = disable).

options.name: disable
options.help: Select new nat port for privileged source ports from priviliged range 512-1023.

options.name: enable
options.help: Select new nat port for privileged source ports from client's port block

subnet-broadcast-in-ippool.name: subnet-broadcast-in-ippool
subnet-broadcast-in-ippool.help: Enable/disable inclusion of the subnetwork address and broadcast IP address in the NAT64 IP pool.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not include the subnetwork address and broadcast IP address in the NAT64 IP pool.

type.name: type
type.help: Configure IPv6 pool type (overload or NPTv6).

options.name: overload
options.help: IPv6 addresses in the IP pool can be shared by clients.

startip.name: startip
startip.help: First IPv6 address (inclusive) in the range for the address pool (format = xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx, default = ::).

endip.name: endip
endip.help: Final IPv6 address (inclusive) in the range for the address pool (format = xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx:xxxx, default = ::).

schema.name: ldb-monitor
schema.help: Configure server load balancing health monitors.

type.name: type
type.help: Select the Monitor type used by the health check monitor to check the health of the server (PING | TCP | HTTP | HTTPS | DNS).

interval.name: interval
interval.help: Time between health checks (5 - 65535 sec, default = 10).

timeout.name: timeout
timeout.help: Time to wait to receive response to a health check from a server. Reaching the timeout means the health check failed (1 - 255 sec, default = 2).

retry.name: retry
retry.help: Number health check attempts before the server is considered down (1 - 255, default = 3).

port.name: port
port.help: Service port used to perform the health check. If 0, health check monitor inherits port configured for the server (0 - 65535, default = 0).

http-get.name: http-get
http-get.help: Request URI used to send a GET request to check the health of an HTTP server. Optionally provide a hostname before the first '/' and it will be used as the HTTP Host Header.

http-match.name: http-match
http-match.help: String to match the value expected in response to an HTTP-GET request.

http-max-redirects.name: http-max-redirects
http-max-redirects.help: The maximum number of HTTP redirects to be allowed (0 - 5, default = 0).

dns-protocol.name: dns-protocol
dns-protocol.help: Select the protocol used by the DNS health check monitor to check the health of the server (UDP | TCP).

dns-request-domain.name: dns-request-domain
dns-request-domain.help: Fully qualified domain name to resolve for the DNS probe.

dns-match-ip.name: dns-match-ip
dns-match-ip.help: Response IP expected from DNS server.

uuid.name: uuid
uuid.help: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID; automatically assigned but can be manually reset).

type.name: type
type.help: Configure a static NAT, load balance, server load balance, access proxy, DNS translation, or FQDN VIP.

server-type.name: server-type
server-type.help: Protocol to be load balanced by the virtual server (also called the server load balance virtual IP).

dns-mapping-ttl.name: dns-mapping-ttl
dns-mapping-ttl.help: DNS mapping TTL (Set to zero to use TTL in DNS response, default = 0).

ldb-method.name: ldb-method
ldb-method.help: Method used to distribute sessions to real servers.

options.name: static
options.help: Distribute to server based on source IP.

options.name: round-robin
options.help: Distribute to server based round robin order.

options.name: weighted
options.help: Distribute to server based on weight.

options.name: least-session
options.help: Distribute to server with lowest session count.

options.name: least-rtt
options.help: Distribute to server with lowest Round-Trip-Time.

options.name: first-alive
options.help: Distribute to the first server that is alive.

options.name: http-host
options.help: Distribute to server based on host field in HTTP header.

src-filter.name: src-filter
src-filter.help: Source address filter. Each address must be either an IP/subnet (x.x.x.x/n) or a range (x.x.x.x-y.y.y.y). Separate addresses with spaces.

src-vip-filter.name: src-vip-filter
src-vip-filter.help: Enable/disable use of 'src-filter' to match destinations for the reverse SNAT rule.

options.name: disable
options.help: Match any destination for the reverse SNAT rule.

options.name: enable
options.help: Match only destinations in 'src-filter' for the reverse SNAT rule.

extip.name: extip
extip.help: IP address or address range on the external interface that you want to map to an address or address range on the destination network.

max-udp-payload-size.name: max-udp-payload-size
max-udp-payload-size.help: Maximum UDP payload size in bytes (1200 - 1500, default = 1500).

max-ack-delay.name: max-ack-delay
max-ack-delay.help: Maximum ACK delay in milliseconds (1 - 16383, default = 25).

max-datagram-frame-size.name: max-datagram-frame-size
max-datagram-frame-size.help: Maximum datagram frame size in bytes (1 - 1500, default = 1500).

mappedip.name: mappedip
mappedip.help: IP address or address range on the destination network to which the external IP address is mapped.

extintf.name: extintf
extintf.help: Interface connected to the source network that receives the packets that will be forwarded to the destination network.

arp-reply.name: arp-reply
arp-reply.help: Enable to respond to ARP requests for this virtual IP address. Enabled by default.

http-redirect.name: http-redirect
http-redirect.help: Enable/disable redirection of HTTP to HTTPS.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable redirection of HTTP to HTTPS.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable redirection of HTTP to HTTPS.

persistence.name: persistence
persistence.help: Configure how to make sure that clients connect to the same server every time they make a request that is part of the same session.

nat-source-vip.name: nat-source-vip
nat-source-vip.help: Enable/disable forcing the source NAT mapped IP to the external IP for all traffic.

options.name: disable
options.help: Force only the source NAT mapped IP to the external IP for traffic egressing the external interface of the VIP.

options.name: enable
options.help: Force the source NAT mapped IP to the external IP for all traffic.

protocol.name: protocol
protocol.help: Protocol to use when forwarding packets.

extport.name: extport
extport.help: Incoming port number range that you want to map to a port number range on the destination network.

mappedport.name: mappedport
mappedport.help: Port number range on the destination network to which the external port number range is mapped.

gratuitous-arp-interval.name: gratuitous-arp-interval
gratuitous-arp-interval.help: Enable to have the VIP send gratuitous ARPs. 0=disabled. Set from 5 up to 8640000 seconds to enable.

srcintf-filter.name: srcintf-filter
srcintf-filter.help: Interfaces to which the VIP applies. Separate the names with spaces.

empty-cert-action.name: empty-cert-action
empty-cert-action.help: Action for an empty client certificate.

options.name: accept
options.help: Accept the SSL handshake if the client certificate is empty.

options.name: block
options.help: Block the SSL handshake if the client certificate is empty.

options.name: accept-unmanageable
options.help: Accept the SSL handshake only if the end-point is unmanageable.

user-agent-detect.name: user-agent-detect
user-agent-detect.help: Enable/disable detecting device type by HTTP user-agent if no client certificate is provided.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable detecting unknown devices by HTTP user-agent if no client certificate is provided.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable detecting unknown devices by HTTP user-agent if no client certificate is provided.

realservers.name: realservers
realservers.help: Select the real servers that this server load balancing VIP will distribute traffic to.

address.name: address
address.help: Dynamic address of the real server.

ip.name: ip
ip.help: IP address of the real server.

port.name: port
port.help: Port for communicating with the real server. Required if port forwarding is enabled.

status.name: status
status.help: Set the status of the real server to active so that it can accept traffic, or on standby or disabled so no traffic is sent.

weight.name: weight
weight.help: Weight of the real server. If weighted load balancing is enabled, the server with the highest weight gets more connections.

holddown-interval.name: holddown-interval
holddown-interval.help: Time in seconds that the system waits before re-activating a previously down active server in the active-standby mode. This is to prevent any flapping issues.

healthcheck.name: healthcheck
healthcheck.help: Enable to check the responsiveness of the real server before forwarding traffic.

options.name: vip
options.help: Use health check defined in VIP.

http-host.name: http-host
http-host.help: HTTP server domain name in HTTP header.

translate-host.name: translate-host
translate-host.help: Enable/disable translation of hostname/IP from virtual server to real server.

max-connections.name: max-connections
max-connections.help: Max number of active connections that can be directed to the real server. When reached, sessions are sent to other real servers.

monitor.name: monitor
monitor.help: Name of the health check monitor to use when polling to determine a virtual server's connectivity status.

client-ip.name: client-ip
client-ip.help: Only clients in this IP range can connect to this real server.

verify-cert.name: verify-cert
verify-cert.help: Enable/disable certificate verification of the real server.

http-cookie-domain-from-host.name: http-cookie-domain-from-host
http-cookie-domain-from-host.help: Enable/disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP (use http-cooke-domain setting).

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable use of HTTP cookie domain from host field in HTTP.

http-cookie-domain.name: http-cookie-domain
http-cookie-domain.help: Domain that HTTP cookie persistence should apply to.

http-cookie-path.name: http-cookie-path
http-cookie-path.help: Limit HTTP cookie persistence to the specified path.

http-cookie-generation.name: http-cookie-generation
http-cookie-generation.help: Generation of HTTP cookie to be accepted. Changing invalidates all existing cookies.

http-cookie-age.name: http-cookie-age
http-cookie-age.help: Time in minutes that client web browsers should keep a cookie. Default is 60 minutes. 0 = no time limit.

http-cookie-share.name: http-cookie-share
http-cookie-share.help: Control sharing of cookies across virtual servers. Use of same-ip means a cookie from one virtual server can be used by another. Disable stops cookie sharing.

options.name: disable
options.help: Only allow HTTP cookie to match this virtual server.

options.name: same-ip
options.help: Allow HTTP cookie to match any virtual server with same IP.

https-cookie-secure.name: https-cookie-secure
https-cookie-secure.help: Enable/disable verification that inserted HTTPS cookies are secure.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not mark cookie as secure, allow sharing between an HTTP and HTTPS connection.

options.name: enable
options.help: Mark inserted cookie as secure, cookie can only be used for HTTPS a connection.

http-multiplex-ttl.name: http-multiplex-ttl
http-multiplex-ttl.help: Time-to-live for idle connections to servers.

http-multiplex-max-request.name: http-multiplex-max-request
http-multiplex-max-request.help: Maximum number of requests that a multiplex server can handle before disconnecting sessions (default = unlimited).

http-multiplex-max-concurrent-request.name: http-multiplex-max-concurrent-request
http-multiplex-max-concurrent-request.help: Maximum number of concurrent requests that a multiplex server can handle (default = unlimited).

http-ip-header.name: http-ip-header
http-ip-header.help: For HTTP multiplexing, enable to add the original client IP address in the X-Forwarded-For HTTP header.

http-ip-header-name.name: http-ip-header-name
http-ip-header-name.help: For HTTP multiplexing, enter a custom HTTPS header name. The original client IP address is added to this header. If empty, X-Forwarded-For is used.

outlook-web-access.name: outlook-web-access
outlook-web-access.help: Enable to add the Front-End-Https header for Microsoft Outlook Web Access.

weblogic-server.name: weblogic-server
weblogic-server.help: Enable to add an HTTP header to indicate SSL offloading for a WebLogic server.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebLogic server.

options.name: enable
options.help: Add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebLogic server.

websphere-server.name: websphere-server
websphere-server.help: Enable to add an HTTP header to indicate SSL offloading for a WebSphere server.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebSphere server.

options.name: enable
options.help: Add HTTP header indicating SSL offload for WebSphere server.

ssl-mode.name: ssl-mode
ssl-mode.help: Apply SSL offloading between the client and the FortiGate (half) or from the client to the FortiGate and from the FortiGate to the server (full).

options.name: full
options.help: Client to FortiGate and FortiGate to Server SSL.

ssl-certificate.name: ssl-certificate
ssl-certificate.help: Name of the certificate to use for SSL handshake.

ssl-dh-bits.name: ssl-dh-bits
ssl-dh-bits.help: Number of bits to use in the Diffie-Hellman exchange for RSA encryption of SSL sessions.

ssl-algorithm.name: ssl-algorithm
ssl-algorithm.help: Permitted encryption algorithms for SSL sessions according to encryption strength.

options.name: high
options.help: High encryption. Allow only AES and ChaCha.

options.name: medium
options.help: Medium encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, and RC4.

options.name: low
options.help: Low encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, RC4, and DES.

options.name: custom
options.help: Custom encryption. Use config ssl-cipher-suites to select the cipher suites that are allowed.

ssl-cipher-suites.name: ssl-cipher-suites
ssl-cipher-suites.help: SSL/TLS cipher suites acceptable from a client, ordered by priority.

versions.name: versions
versions.help: SSL/TLS versions that the cipher suite can be used with.

ssl-server-algorithm.name: ssl-server-algorithm
ssl-server-algorithm.help: Permitted encryption algorithms for the server side of SSL full mode sessions according to encryption strength.

options.name: high
options.help: High encryption. Allow only AES and ChaCha.

options.name: medium
options.help: Medium encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, and RC4.

options.name: low
options.help: Low encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, RC4, and DES.

options.name: custom
options.help: Custom encryption. Use ssl-server-cipher-suites to select the cipher suites that are allowed.

options.name: client
options.help: Use the same encryption algorithms for both client and server sessions.

ssl-server-cipher-suites.name: ssl-server-cipher-suites
ssl-server-cipher-suites.help: SSL/TLS cipher suites to offer to a server, ordered by priority.

versions.name: versions
versions.help: SSL/TLS versions that the cipher suite can be used with.

ssl-pfs.name: ssl-pfs
ssl-pfs.help: Select the cipher suites that can be used for SSL perfect forward secrecy (PFS). Applies to both client and server sessions.

options.name: require
options.help: Allow only Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is applied.

options.name: deny
options.help: Allow only non-Diffie-Hellman cipher-suites, so PFS is not applied.

options.name: allow
options.help: Allow use of any cipher suite so PFS may or may not be used depending on the cipher suite selected.

ssl-min-version.name: ssl-min-version
ssl-min-version.help: Lowest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a client.

ssl-max-version.name: ssl-max-version
ssl-max-version.help: Highest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a client.

ssl-server-min-version.name: ssl-server-min-version
ssl-server-min-version.help: Lowest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a server. Use the client setting by default.

options.name: client
options.help: Use same value as client configuration.

ssl-server-max-version.name: ssl-server-max-version
ssl-server-max-version.help: Highest SSL/TLS version acceptable from a server. Use the client setting by default.

options.name: client
options.help: Use same value as client configuration.

ssl-accept-ffdhe-groups.name: ssl-accept-ffdhe-groups
ssl-accept-ffdhe-groups.help: Enable/disable FFDHE cipher suite for SSL key exchange.

ssl-send-empty-frags.name: ssl-send-empty-frags
ssl-send-empty-frags.help: Enable/disable sending empty fragments to avoid CBC IV attacks (SSL 3.0 & TLS 1.0 only). May need to be disabled for compatibility with older systems.

ssl-client-fallback.name: ssl-client-fallback
ssl-client-fallback.help: Enable/disable support for preventing Downgrade Attacks on client connections (RFC 7507).

ssl-client-renegotiation.name: ssl-client-renegotiation
ssl-client-renegotiation.help: Allow, deny, or require secure renegotiation of client sessions to comply with RFC 5746.

options.name: allow
options.help: Allow a SSL client to renegotiate.

options.name: deny
options.help: Abort any client initiated SSL re-negotiation attempt.

options.name: secure
options.help: Abort any client initiated SSL re-negotiation attempt that does not use RFC 5746 Secure Renegotiation.

ssl-client-session-state-type.name: ssl-client-session-state-type
ssl-client-session-state-type.help: How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the client and the FortiGate.

options.name: time
options.help: Expire session states after this many minutes.

options.name: count
options.help: Expire session states when this maximum is reached.

options.name: both
options.help: Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-client-session-state-timeout.name: ssl-client-session-state-timeout
ssl-client-session-state-timeout.help: Number of minutes to keep client to FortiGate SSL session state.

ssl-client-session-state-max.name: ssl-client-session-state-max
ssl-client-session-state-max.help: Maximum number of client to FortiGate SSL session states to keep.

ssl-client-rekey-count.name: ssl-client-rekey-count
ssl-client-rekey-count.help: Maximum length of data in MB before triggering a client rekey (0 = disable).

ssl-server-renegotiation.name: ssl-server-renegotiation
ssl-server-renegotiation.help: Enable/disable secure renegotiation to comply with RFC 5746.

ssl-server-session-state-type.name: ssl-server-session-state-type
ssl-server-session-state-type.help: How to expire SSL sessions for the segment of the SSL connection between the server and the FortiGate.

options.name: time
options.help: Expire session states after this many minutes.

options.name: count
options.help: Expire session states when this maximum is reached.

options.name: both
options.help: Expire session states based on time or count, whichever occurs first.

ssl-server-session-state-timeout.name: ssl-server-session-state-timeout
ssl-server-session-state-timeout.help: Number of minutes to keep FortiGate to Server SSL session state.

ssl-server-session-state-max.name: ssl-server-session-state-max
ssl-server-session-state-max.help: Maximum number of FortiGate to Server SSL session states to keep.

ssl-http-location-conversion.name: ssl-http-location-conversion
ssl-http-location-conversion.help: Enable to replace HTTP with HTTPS in the reply's Location HTTP header field.

ssl-http-match-host.name: ssl-http-match-host
ssl-http-match-host.help: Enable/disable HTTP host matching for location conversion.

options.name: enable
options.help: Match HTTP host in response header.

ssl-hpkp.name: ssl-hpkp
ssl-hpkp.help: Enable/disable including HPKP header in response.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not add a HPKP header to each HTTP response.

options.name: enable
options.help: Add a HPKP header to each a HTTP response.

options.name: report-only
options.help: Add a HPKP Report-Only header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hpkp-primary.name: ssl-hpkp-primary
ssl-hpkp-primary.help: Certificate to generate primary HPKP pin from.

ssl-hpkp-backup.name: ssl-hpkp-backup
ssl-hpkp-backup.help: Certificate to generate backup HPKP pin from.

ssl-hpkp-age.name: ssl-hpkp-age
ssl-hpkp-age.help: Number of seconds the client should honor the HPKP setting.

ssl-hpkp-report-uri.name: ssl-hpkp-report-uri
ssl-hpkp-report-uri.help: URL to report HPKP violations to.

ssl-hpkp-include-subdomains.name: ssl-hpkp-include-subdomains
ssl-hpkp-include-subdomains.help: Indicate that HPKP header applies to all subdomains.

options.name: disable
options.help: HPKP header does not apply to subdomains.

ssl-hsts.name: ssl-hsts
ssl-hsts.help: Enable/disable including HSTS header in response.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not add a HSTS header to each a HTTP response.

options.name: enable
options.help: Add a HSTS header to each HTTP response.

ssl-hsts-age.name: ssl-hsts-age
ssl-hsts-age.help: Number of seconds the client should honor the HSTS setting.

ssl-hsts-include-subdomains.name: ssl-hsts-include-subdomains
ssl-hsts-include-subdomains.help: Indicate that HSTS header applies to all subdomains.

options.name: disable
options.help: HSTS header does not apply to subdomains.

color.help: Color of icon on the GUI.
